<thought>To find the appropriate retrosynthetic template for the given molecule, I will search the template catalog for templates where a double bond order changes from double to single (C=C to C‑C), which is characteristic of a Diels‑Alder reaction. This should return candidate templates, from which I can later verify applicability.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O",
  "bonds_order_changed": ["C=C (2.0->1.0)"]
}</action_input>
